goal: A deterministic QA command is whatever the absolute-entry PATH provides: command resolution stops interpreting '#!' lines, pins and executes the resolved entry file directly and lets the operating system resolve any interpreter, so a tool behind a version-manager shim runs instead of being refused; FrozenCommand loses its interpreter fields, and the Planner contract names sh -c as the way to write a compound command (Spec host-owned-environment S2; D6, D7, I3).

acceptance.assertion: Through resolveVerificationCommand and runFixedVerification with real child processes: a host tool whose '#!' line names another script runs, a tool using 'env -S' runs, an entry file replaced during the run fails the identity check, and a timeout removes every process of the run; seam: tests/pi-canary-verification-descriptor.test.ts (Spec SCN-5, D6, I3).

A descriptor with executable sh and argv ['-c', 'true && exit 3'] yields exit status 3; descriptor bounds still reject an over-long argv and an executable with a path separator; dist/imm-planner.md names sh -c for compound commands; the generated Claude bundle matches the runtime source; seams: tests/pi-canary-verification-descriptor.test.ts, tests/kernel-verification-descriptor.test.ts, tests/workflow-verification-invariants.test.ts, tests/claude-host-package.test.ts (Spec SCN-4, D7).
